answer: Require agents to earn trust on a ladder: a new agent starts with tiny, capped transaction rights and climbs only through verified work history. Like a trellis, each rung is earned proof, so a sybil farmer cannot cheaply clone the whole structure. Bind reputation to a scarce, non-transferable credential - an onyx anchor tied to one long-lived identity - and let trust decay, so dormant clones lose standing. The horizon stretches for attackers: one real identity is cheap, but sustaining hundreds with real history and staked value costs more than the attack is worth.
